metcon.name: Partner Workout
metcon.description:
3 rounds for time
400m run together
30 KB Snatches 24/16kg
6 rope climbs
6 wall walks
Partition as required
RX+ KB @ 32/24
scale rope climb to partial height rope climb or pull from ground
Big hinge on KB, but keep tight and punch up
Hollow position on wall walk
WW - reps start and finish with chest on the ground

hypertrophy.reasoning: Address pulling strength and posterior chain while minimizing overlap with today's pressing, climbing, and running demands.
suggested_exercises: Weighted pull-ups or lat pulldowns: 3 x 6-8
Leg press or Bulgarian split squats: 3 x 8-10

siri_text: Saturday's workout. Metcon: Partner Workout. Rounds for Time: 400m run together, 30 KB Snatches 24/16kg, 6 rope climbs, 6 wall walks, Partition as required. For hypertrophy, focus on back (lats), biceps, glutes.
